title: Role-based mode uses profile rank — no role tree, no branch rule, no Share Data with Peers

panels.caption: Security Control → Org Units (separate tree, used for scope)
Security Control → Roles and Sharing → Roles (CEO → Manager)
Role rules (docs)
text: Roles are separate from Profiles: profiles give permissions, roles decide whose data you see.
A superior sees the records of their own branch (all levels below), not the whole tenant.
Each role has "Share Data with Peers" (off by default). It is hidden in Reporting mode.
A role with users or sub-roles is removed with Transfer & Delete.

rows.tavi: Profile rank (CRM Admin 700 › Manager 500 › Supervisor 300 › User 100)
Preview: "every User in the tenant"; module hint: "lower-ranked users in their department"

notes: Users with two profiles (e.g. CRM Admin + Desk Administrator) have no single rank.
